sun.security.provider.certpath

类 OCSPNonceExtension

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.security.x509.Extension
      • sun.security.provider.certpath.OCSPNonceExtension
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    Extension

    public final class OCSPNonceExtension
extends Extension
    Represent the OCSP Nonce Extension. This extension, if present, provides a nonce value in OCSP requests and responses. This will cryptographically bind requests and responses and help to prevent replay attacks (see RFC 6960, section 4.4.1).
    另请参阅:

    • 构造器详细资料

      • OCSPNonceExtension

        public OCSPNonceExtension(int length)
                   throws IOException
        Create an OCSPNonceExtension by providing the nonce length. The criticality is set to false, and the OID for the extension will be the value defined by "id-pkix-ocsp-nonce" from RFC 6960.
        参数:
        length - the number of random bytes composing the nonce
        抛出:
        IOException - if any errors happen during encoding of the extension.
        IllegalArgumentException - if length is not a positive integer.

      • OCSPNonceExtension

        public OCSPNonceExtension(boolean isCritical,
                          int length)
                   throws IOException
        Create an OCSPNonceExtension by providing the nonce length and criticality setting. The OID for the extension will be the value defined by "id-pkix-ocsp-nonce" from RFC 6960.
        参数:
        isCritical - a boolean flag indicating whether the criticality bit is set for this extension
        length - the number of random bytes composing the nonce
        抛出:
        IOException - if any errors happen during encoding of the extension.
        IllegalArgumentException - if length is not a positive integer.

      • OCSPNonceExtension

        public OCSPNonceExtension(byte[] incomingNonce)
                   throws IOException
        Create an OCSPNonceExtension by providing a nonce value. The criticality is set to false, and the OID for the extension will be the value defined by "id-pkix-ocsp-nonce" from RFC 6960.
        参数:
        incomingNonce - The nonce data to be set for the extension. This must be a non-null array of at least one byte long.
        抛出:
        IOException - if any errors happen during encoding of the extension.
        IllegalArgumentException - if the incomingNonce length is not a positive integer.
        NullPointerException - if the incomingNonce is null.

      • OCSPNonceExtension

        参数:

        incomingNonce - The nonce data to be set for the extension. This must be a non-null array of at least one byte long.
